subject.title: [Feature]: Add screenshot capture button to Control UI chat input (like Doubao)

question: Should OpenClaw add a dedicated static screenshot capture button to the Control UI chat composer now, and what privacy/permission boundary should it use?
rationale: The implementation boundary is plausible, but choosing browser/native capture, consent semantics, private-pixel handling, and provider-facing attachment behavior is product/security intent that automation should not decide.

options.title: Define capture boundary first
options.body: Keep this issue open and require maintainer-approved consent, cancel, preview/removal, logging/redaction, provider-retention, and platform behavior before implementation.

options.title: Approve browser-only static capture
options.body: Proceed with a narrow browser still-capture PR that reuses the existing attachment pipeline and includes real browser proof.

options.title: Defer to current attachments
options.body: Do not add a dedicated capture affordance yet and rely on paste, drop, file, photo, and camera attachment paths while the broader visual-context design remains open.

recommendation.title: Define capture boundary first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require maintainer-approved consent, cancel, preview/removal, logging/redaction, provider-retention, and platform behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main history on the split Control UI chat composer attachment path and is the best available owner for the capture-boundary choice.
